test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
India is set to establish its first public–private partnership (PPP) model medical colleges to expand medical education, strengthen district hospitals, and improve healthcare access in tribal and underserved regions. The foundation stones for the initial colleges were laid in the presence of key health and state officials.

In which Indian state are India’s first PPP-model medical colleges being set up?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India will establish its first PPP-model medical colleges in the tribal districts of Dhar and Betul in Madhya Pradesh to strengthen medical education and district hospitals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Dhar and Betul districts will host the first phase of PPP-model medical colleges in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Under the PPP framework, state provides land while private partners construct academic and clinical infrastructure.
 
• District hospitals will be upgraded as teaching hospitals in accordance with National Medical Commission (NMC) norms.
 
• Four PPP medical colleges are planned in Madhya Pradesh covering Dhar, Betul, Katni, and Panna districts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Objectives of PPP Model Medical Colleges

 
 
• Expand medical education infrastructure in underserved and tribal regions
 
• Improve availability of doctors and medical professionals locally
 
• Encourage private investment in public healthcare education
 
• Support inclusive and equitable healthcare growth in backward areas
 
 
 
• PPP Model Explained
 
 
• State government provides up to 25 acres of land on lease
 
• Private partners construct college buildings, hostels, laboratories, and residential facilities
 
• Hospitals remain under state control to ensure uninterrupted public healthcare
 
 
 
• Significance
 
 
• Represents a historic milestone in India’s medical education and healthcare expansion
 
• Focuses on preventive, promotive, and holistic healthcare alongside curative services
